text:
marie: quick snafu check — final RN draft attached below. planning a soft roll at 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC (that's 00:00 JST next day). can the oncall/asia rotation confirm standby?

marie: short changelog: 
- Runtime: reduce p99 GPU jitter via KV-cache prewarm (v2.1.4)
- API: add `prefer-low-latency` header for routing by policy
- Console: rollout small dashboard perf improvements (no schema changes)

marie: pinning: we'll pin model-serving image `redwood/serve:2026-04-02-1` across hosted + dedicated for this rollout. rollback lane uses `redwood/serve:2026-03-20-stable`.

marie: deploybot scheduled the canary at 2026-04-02T16:00Z; full rollout + traffic spin at +30m if no regressions. ops-bot: please run the smoke checklist at canary start.

sam: reading. quick Q — are there any evals tied to the `prefer-low-latency` flag?

marie: yes, we ran small eval set (latency-first) — no quality regression vs baseline. full eval report is linked: https://internal.redwood/reports/latency-2026-03-31

jordan: oncall (APAC) ok to cover midnight JST? i can be standby but prefer not primary if anything shows upstream model flakiness.

anya: i can take primary for the window. will be available 23:30–02:30 JST. tagging runbook owners: @sam for model metrics, @alex for infra rollback.

alex: understood. rollback plan: if error-rate > 0.5% p50 across 5m or latency p99 regresses > 30% vs baseline, we revert to `2026-03-20-stable` and remove `prefer-low-latency` header routing. revert command (dry-run):
```
./deploy rollback --image redwood/serve:2026-03-20-stable --routes host, dedicated
```

alex: also keep `--drain-grace=45s` to avoid inflight token truncation.

sam: microcopy for internal announce — suggested lead: "Performance rollout: lower tail latency for serving runtime" body should call out pin, canary time, oncall, rollback lane, and ask product folks to *not* push schema changes during window.

marie: copying that. draft internal announcement below — please thumbs up or suggest edits: 

"Heads-up: We will rollout a serving runtime update on 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC (00:00 JST). This change introduces a KV-cache prewarm and a `prefer-low-latency` routing hint which reduces p99 latency for typical chat workloads. No schema changes expected. Canary at T=0 (+30m monitor), full rollout if green. 

If you own integrations that pin model images or expect stable inference behavior, please verify after T+45m. If you cannot be reached in the window, reply here so we coordinate. Rollback lane: revert to redwood/serve:2026-03-20-stable.

Oncall: @anya (primary), @jordan (secondary). Ops: @alex.

Thanks — marie"

jordan: tiny edit — include a one-line note to product: "no behavioral changes expected, but please run your smoke prompts after T+45m."

marie: added. new draft pinned in thread.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary job `canary-2026-04-02-16-00` created by marie. Steps: create canary pool (5 GPUs), route 2% traffic, run smoke tests, collect metrics.

ops-bot: smoke checklist reminder: 
- smoke ping endpoint /health 0/1
- run 5 synthetic prompts across locales
- validate telemetry keys for kv-cache hitrate

anya: all set on my side. i've left a sticky with my phone and we'll use SMS if Slack is flaky.

sam: :thumbsup: approving copy. one ask — can we add a short note in the RN about cost impact? even if small.

marie: good call. adding: "expected cost delta: +3–5% CPU/GPU utilization for brief prewarm window; ongoing costs unchanged."

alex: infra note — autoscaler min=2 for canary pool. if we see steady queue length > 100 for 10m, fallback to reserve capacity lane and notify @eng-infra.

marie: final checklist before closing thread:
- [x] RN copy approved (sam)
- [x] Oncall roster confirmed (anya, jordan)
- [x] Rollback command validated (alex)
- [x] Deploybot job created
- [x] Ops smoke checklist in thread
- [ ] Product signoff for smoke prompts (pinging product separately)

marie: if no objections i'll post the internal announce at 2026-04-01 12:00 UTC (to give APAC and EA teams 28h heads-up).

alex: sounds good. i'll stand by for rollback if needed.

jordan: thanks, team.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: "canary-2026-04-02-16-00 in 24h" (will post in channel at 2026-04-01T16:00Z).

marie: thanks folks — closing thread unless someone requests further edits. :rocket:
